descriptors.name: refdata.SettlementMethod
descriptors.label: Settlement Method
descriptors.description: How the money moves for a settlement instruction — the abstract polymorphic base of BankTransfer, CustodyAccount and CashSweep, stored as JSON inside the instruction. Never persisted on its own.

label.name: label
label.label: Label
label.description: Short human-readable label for this method, e.g. 'USD Chase wire'.

notes.name: notes
notes.label: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text notes about the method (cut-off times, correspondent details).
